The State Street Equity 500 Index Fund, State Street Global All Cap Equity ex-U.S. Index Fund, State Street Aggregate Bond Index Fund and State Street Small/Mid Cap Equity Index Fund (the Funds) invest all of their respective investable assets in a corresponding similarly named master portfolio (State Street Equity 500 Index II Portfolio, State Street Global All Cap Equity ex-U.S. Index Portfolio, State Street Aggregate Bond Index Portfolio and State Street Small/Mid Cap Equity Index Portfolio) (the Portfolios)) of the State Street Institutional Investment Trust. There were no matters relating to the Portfolios considered at any shareholder meeting held during the period covered by this report with respect to which the Funds were entitled to vote. The proxy voting record of the Portfolios is set forth in their Form N-PX filings for the reporting period. There is no proxy voting activity for the Funds, as the Funds did not hold any votable positions during the reporting period.
The State Street Institutional Liquid Reserves Government Money Market Fund, State Street Institutional U.S. Government Money Market Fund, State Street Institutional Treasury Money Market Fund, and State Street Institutional Treasury Plus Money Market Fund (the Funds) invest all of their respective investable assets in a corresponding similarly named master portfolio (State Street Money Market Portfolio, State Street U.S. Government Money Market Portfolio, State Street Treasury Money Market Portfolio, and State Street Treasury Plus Money Market Portfolio) (the Portfolios)) of the State Street Master Funds. There were no matters relating to the Portfolios considered at any shareholder meeting held during the period covered by this report with respect to which the Funds were entitled to vote. The proxy voting record of the Portfolios is set forth in their Form N-PX filings for the reporting period. There is no proxy voting activity for the Funds, as the Funds did not hold any votable positions during the reporting period.
The State Street Hedged International Developed Equity Index Fund (the Fund) invests a portion of its assets in the State Street International Developed Equity Index Portfolio (the Portfolio) a series of the State Street Master Funds, as described in the Funds prospectus. There were no matters relating to the Portfolio considered at any shareholder meeting held during the period covered by this report with respect to which the Fund was entitled to vote. During the reporting period, the Fund held votable positions and participated in proxy voting activity. The proxy voting record of the Portfolio is set forth in the State Street Master Funds Form N-PX filing for the reporting period. The Funds proxy voting activity is included in this report and reflects votes cast on positions held during the period and outside of the Portfolio proxy voting activity.
The State Street Treasury Obligations Money Market Fund (Treasury Fund) invests all of its investable assets in the State Street Treasury Plus Money Market Portfolio (Treasury Portfolio), a series of State Street Master Funds. There were no matters relating to the Treasury Portfolio considered at any shareholder meeting held during the period covered by this report with respect to which the Treasury Fund was entitled to vote. The Treasury Portfolio did not hold any securities for which it voted a proxy during the reporting period. There is no proxy voting activity for the Treasury Fund, as the Treasury Fund did not hold any votable positions during the reporting period.
